# h3_k8s_node_pools (Data Source)

Worker pools (node pools) of a managed Kubernetes cluster with their state. A cluster created with `workers` shows them as the pool `default`. Uses API-key (HMAC) access to h3k8s (`api.h3llo.cloud/api/k8s/v3`): the key must list the project; scope `k8s:read` is enough to read, changes and the kubeconfig (admin credentials) need `k8s:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_k8s_node_pools" "main" {
  cluster_id = h3_k8s_cluster.main.id
}

output "node_pools" {
  value = { for p in data.h3_k8s_node_pools.main.node_pools : p.name => "${p.current_replicas}/${p.status}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted

### Read-Only

- `node_pools` (Attributes List) Pools in the order of the cluster spec (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools))

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools`

Read-Only:

- `autoscaling_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pool is autoscaled
- `autoscaling_max_size` (Number) Autoscaling upper bound; null without autoscaling
- `autoscaling_min_size` (Number) Autoscaling lower bound; null without autoscaling
- `billed_replicas` (Number) Nodes billed now
- `cpu` (Number) vCPU per node
- `current_replicas` (Number) Nodes the pool has now
- `desired_replicas` (Number) Nodes the pool should have now
- `disk_gi` (Number) System disk per node, GiB
- `disk_profile` (String) `replicated` or `local`
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version of the pool nodes
- `labels` (Map of String) Node labels
- `max_pods` (Number) Maximum pods per node; null = platform default
- `memory_gi` (Number) Memory per node, GiB
- `name` (String) Pool name
- `ready_replicas` (Number) Ready nodes
- `replicas` (Number) Configured nodes (the lower bound with autoscaling)
- `status` (String) `READY`, `PROVISIONING`, `SCALING`, `ROLLING_OUT`, `DELETING` or `UNKNOWN`
- `taints` (Attributes List) Node taints (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools--taints))

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools.taints`

Read-Only:

- `effect` (String) Taint effect
- `key` (String) Taint key
- `value` (String) Taint value
